package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	journeyStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	journeyCourseID  = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	journeyLessonID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	journeyPathID    = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	journeySessionID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	journeyAssessID  = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	journeySnapshot  = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
)

type learningJourneyRepositoryStub struct {
	path             domain.StudentLearningPath
	diagnostic       domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot
	session          domain.StudentLearningSession
	updates          int
	pathReplacements int
	err              error
	creationRequest  repository.LearningPathCreationRequest
	createdPath      domain.StudentLearningPath
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) CreateLearningPathIdempotently(
	_ context.Context,
	path domain.StudentLearningPath,
	request repository.LearningPathCreationRequest,
) (domain.StudentLearningPath, bool, error) {
	if stub.createdPath.ID != "" {
		if stub.creationRequest.RequestHash != request.RequestHash {
			return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return stub.createdPath, true, stub.err
	}
	stub.creationRequest = request
	stub.createdPath = path
	stub.createdPath.IsPrimary = true
	stub.createdPath.IsSelected = true
	return stub.createdPath, false, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) GetLearningPath(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	return stub.path, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) ReplaceLearningPath(_ context.Context, path domain.StudentLearningPath, _ int64) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	stub.pathReplacements++
	stub.path = path
	return path, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) SaveDiagnosticSnapshot(_ context.Context, snapshot domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error) {
	stub.diagnostic = snapshot
	return snapshot, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error) {
	return stub.diagnostic, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) CreateLearningSession(_ context.Context, session domain.StudentLearningSession) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	stub.session = session
	return session, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) GetLearningSession(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	return stub.session, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) UpdateLearningSession(_ context.Context, session domain.StudentLearningSession, _ int64) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	stub.updates++
	stub.session = session
	return session, stub.err
}

func (stub *learningJourneyRepositoryStub) ListRecentLearningSessions(context.Context, string, int) ([]domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	return []domain.StudentLearningSession{stub.session}, stub.err
}

type journeyIDStub struct{ values []string }

func (stub *journeyIDStub) NewID() string {
	value := stub.values[0]
	stub.values = stub.values[1:]
	return value
}

type masteryProjectionStub struct{ items []domain.StudentTargetMastery }

func (stub masteryProjectionStub) Handle(context.Context, string, []domain.LearningTargetRef) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	return stub.items, nil
}

type learningPathStateRepositoryStub struct {
	paths                 []domain.StudentLearningPath
	contextValue          domain.StudentLearningContext
	activationVersionSeen int64
}

func (stub *learningPathStateRepositoryStub) GetLearningPathByID(
	_ context.Context, _, pathID string,
) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	for _, path := range stub.paths {
		if path.ID == pathID {
			return path, nil
		}
	}
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *learningPathStateRepositoryStub) ListLearningPaths(
	context.Context, string, int,
) ([]domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	return stub.paths, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathStateRepositoryStub) GetLearningContext(
	context.Context, string,
) (domain.StudentLearningContext, error) {
	return stub.contextValue, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathStateRepositoryStub) ActivateLearningPath(
	_ context.Context, _, _ string, expectedVersion int64, _ bool, _ time.Time,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	stub.activationVersionSeen = expectedVersion
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{Path: stub.paths[0], Context: stub.contextValue}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathStateRepositoryStub) PauseLearningPath(
	context.Context, string, string, int64, time.Time,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathStateRepositoryStub) ResumeLearningPath(
	context.Context, string, string, int64, time.Time,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, nil
}

func TestReplaceLearningPathCreatesVersionedStudentOwnedRoute(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := ReplaceLearningPath{
		Journey: repository,
		Clock:   onboardingClockStub{now: now},
		IDs:     &journeyIDStub{values: []string{journeyPathID}},
	}
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), ReplaceLearningPathInput{
		StudentID: journeyStudentID, CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "first-job",
		CurriculumRevision: "sha256:curriculum", ReasonCode: "initial_gap_analysis",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "teacher-curriculum-planner-v1",
		ReasonSummary:        "First current gap is ready.", ExpectedVersion: 0,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0,
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace learning path: %v", err)
	}
	if result.ID != journeyPathID || result.Version != 1 || result.PolicyVersion != domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion || result.PlannerPolicyVersion != "teacher-curriculum-planner-v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected learning path: %+v", result)
	}
	if result.CreatedAt != now || result.UpdatedAt != now || repository.path.StudentID != journeyStudentID {
		t.Fatalf("path ownership/version metadata was not persisted: %+v", repository.path)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLearningPathRejectsMissingDependenciesWithoutPanic(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := (ReplaceLearningPath{}).Handle(context.Background(), ReplaceLearningPathInput{StudentID: journeyStudentID})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLearningPathIdempotentCreateReusesStudentAllocatedPathID(t *testing.T) {
	repositoryStub := &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := ReplaceLearningPath{
		Journey: repositoryStub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
		IDs: &journeyIDStub{values: []string{journeyPathID, journeySessionID}},
	}
	input := ReplaceLearningPathInput{
		StudentID: journeyStudentID, PlanningRequestID: journeySnapshot, IdempotencyKey: journeySnapshot,
		CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "go.backend", CurriculumRevision: "fingerprint-v1",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Build a Go API",
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0,
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	}
	created, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create learning path: %v", err)
	}
	replayed, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replay learning path: %v", err)
	}
	if created.ID != journeyPathID || replayed.ID != created.ID || repositoryStub.creationRequest.RequestHash == "" {
		t.Fatalf("path allocation was not replay-stable: created=%+v replayed=%+v", created, replayed)
	}
}

func TestInitialPathContextFenceIsPairedAndChangesIdempotencyHash(t *testing.T) {
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{StudentID: journeyStudentID, GoalCode: "go.backend"}
	legacy := learningPathCreationRequestHash(path)
	if legacy != "d0b5c91b742650cd7738cda2b6d27ba54da972840b9a2b767c13fbb5441c7abe" {
		t.Fatal("legacy allocation payload hash changed")
	}
	fenced := learningPathCreationRequestHash(path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{ExpectedOnboardingVersion: 2, ExpectedDirectionCode: "backend"})
	if legacy == fenced || legacy != learningPathCreationRequestHash(path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{}) {
		t.Fatal("fence must change hash while absent fence preserves legacy hash")
	}
	for _, input := range []ReplaceLearningPathInput{
		{ExpectedOnboardingVersion: 2}, {ExpectedDirectionCode: "backend"},
		{ExpectedOnboardingVersion: -1, ExpectedDirectionCode: "backend"},
		{ExpectedOnboardingVersion: 2, ExpectedDirectionCode: "backend", ExpectedVersion: 1},
	} {
		input.StudentID = journeyStudentID
		uc := ReplaceLearningPath{Journey: &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{}, Clock: onboardingClockStub{}, IDs: &journeyIDStub{}}
		if _, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), input); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Fatalf("invalid fence accepted: %+v: %v", input, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestLearningPathsListProjectsOneSelectedPathAndJourneyVersion(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{
		ID: journeyPathID, StudentID: journeyStudentID, CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CurriculumRevision: "fingerprint-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Build a Go API",
		Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, IsPrimary: true, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0,
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	}
	contextUpdatedAt := now
	repositoryStub := &learningPathStateRepositoryStub{
		paths: []domain.StudentLearningPath{path},
		contextValue: domain.StudentLearningContext{
			Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: journeyStudentID,
			SelectedLearningPathID: journeyPathID, Version: 3, UpdatedAt: &contextUpdatedAt,
		},
	}
	useCase := LearningPaths{Paths: repositoryStub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}
	result, err := useCase.List(context.Background(), journeyStudentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("list learning paths: %v", err)
	}
	if result.JourneyVersion != 3 || len(result.Items) != 1 || !result.Items[0].IsSelected ||
		result.Items[0].CurrentItem == nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected path projection: %+v", result)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Activate(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, journeyPathID, 3, true); err != nil ||
		repositoryStub.activationVersionSeen != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("journey version was not forwarded: seen=%d err=%v", repositoryStub.activationVersionSeen, err)
	}
}

func TestCompleteLearningPathMarksRemainingItemsAndIsReplaySafe(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	now := createdAt.Add(time.Hour)
	repository := &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{path: domain.StudentLearningPath{
		ID: journeyPathID, StudentID: journeyStudentID, CourseID: journeyCourseID, GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CurriculumRevision: "fingerprint-v1", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Initial route", Version: 2,
		CreatedAt: createdAt, UpdatedAt: createdAt,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{
			{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeyLessonID, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap"},
			{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: journeySessionID, Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted, ReasonCode: "completed"},
		},
	}}
	useCase := CompleteLearningPath{Journey: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}
	input := CompleteLearningPathInput{
		StudentID: journeyStudentID, GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap",
		ReasonSummary: "All required targets are mastered", ExpectedVersion: 2,
	}
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("complete learning path: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Version != 3 || result.Items[0].Status != domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered ||
		result.Items[1].Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted || repository.pathReplacements != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected completed path: %+v replacements=%d", result, repository.pathReplacements)
	}
	input.ExpectedVersion = 3
	replayed, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), input)
	if err != nil || replayed.Version != 3 || repository.pathReplacements != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("completion replay churned the path: result=%+v replacements=%d err=%v", replayed, repository.pathReplacements, err)
	}
}

func TestCompleteLearningPathRejectsAnotherGoal(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{path: domain.StudentLearningPath{
		StudentID: journeyStudentID, GoalCode: "other.goal", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", Version: 2,
	}}
	_, err := (CompleteLearningPath{Journey: repository, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Now()}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), CompleteLearningPathInput{
			StudentID: journeyStudentID, GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
			PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "mastery_no_gap",
			ReasonSummary: "All required targets are mastered", ExpectedVersion: 2,
		},
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected goal conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCaptureDiagnosticPersistsExplicitUnknownState(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"}
	repository := &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := CaptureDiagnosticSnapshot{
		Journey: repository,
		Mastery: masteryProjectionStub{items: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{{Target: target, State: domain.TargetMasteryUnknown}}},
		Clock:   onboardingClockStub{now: now},
		IDs:     &journeyIDStub{values: []string{journeySnapshot}},
	}
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), CaptureDiagnosticInput{
		StudentID: journeyStudentID, AssessmentID: journeyAssessID,
		CurriculumRevision: "sha256:curriculum", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("capture diagnostic: %v", err)
	}
	if len(result.Items) != 1 || result.Items[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryUnknown || result.CompletedAt != now {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected diagnostic snapshot: %+v", result)
	}
}

func TestLearningSessionLifecycleUsesOptimisticVersioning(t *testing.T) {
	start := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &learningJourneyRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := LearningSessions{
		Journey: repository,
		Clock:   onboardingClockStub{now: start},
		IDs:     &journeyIDStub{values: []string{journeySessionID}},
	}
	created, err := useCase.Start(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, "Practice interfaces", journeyCourseID, journeyLessonID, "", journeyAssessID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("start learning session: %v", err)
	}
	if created.Version != 1 || created.EndedAt != nil || created.AnalyticsSessionID != journeyAssessID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected new session: %+v", created)
	}
	useCase.Clock = onboardingClockStub{now: start.Add(30 * time.Minute)}
	ended, err := useCase.End(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, journeySessionID, 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("end learning session: %v", err)
	}
	if ended.Version != 2 || ended.EndedAt == nil || !ended.EndedAt.Equal(start.Add(30*time.Minute)) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected ended session: %+v", ended)
	}
	useCase.Clock = onboardingClockStub{now: start.Add(31 * time.Minute)}
	withMetrics, err := useCase.ApplyMetrics(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, journeySessionID, 2, LearningSessionMetrics{
		AnalyticsSessionID: journeyAssessID, ActiveLearningSeconds: 1200, LessonCount: 1, TaskCount: 2,
		QuestionCount: 3, SelectedExplanationCount: 4, CodeRunCount: 5, FailureCount: 2,
		PassedTestCount: 3, HintCount: 1, TeacherInterventionCount: 1, StuckSignalCount: 1,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("apply session metrics: %v", err)
	}
	if withMetrics.Version != 3 || withMetrics.ActiveLearningSeconds != 1200 || withMetrics.CodeRunCount != 5 ||
		withMetrics.PassedTestCount != 3 || withMetrics.StuckSignalCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected session metrics: %+v", withMetrics)
	}
	replayed, err := useCase.ApplyMetrics(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, journeySessionID, 3, LearningSessionMetrics{
		AnalyticsSessionID: journeyAssessID, ActiveLearningSeconds: 1200, LessonCount: 1, TaskCount: 2,
		QuestionCount: 3, SelectedExplanationCount: 4, CodeRunCount: 5, FailureCount: 2,
		PassedTestCount: 3, HintCount: 1, TeacherInterventionCount: 1, StuckSignalCount: 1,
	})
	if err != nil || replayed.Version != 3 || repository.updates != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("identical metric replay must be a no-op: session=%+v updates=%d err=%v", replayed, repository.updates, err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.End(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, journeySessionID, 1); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected stale session conflict, got %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.ListRecent(context.Background(), journeyStudentID, 21); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected bounded list validation, got %v", err)
	}
}
